purpose: Resolve the identity, registry-recorded use terms and version metadata of the primary Dryad archive cited by the dielectric paper; no data acquisition or admission.

identity_basis.corroboration: The exact DOI appears both in the reference DOI field and its Petousis2017 Dryad citation text; exactly one distinct Dryad DOI was found. Earlier article-methods prose identifies a Dryad JSON deposit.

response_handling: Retain exact bounded response/status/time/hash. Require HTTP200, UTF8 JSON and exact DOI identity. Otherwise preserve first failure and stop with no retry, mirror, fallback host or identifier guess.
selected_fields: dates and registry created/updated timestamps, explicitly not substituted for dataset version
exposure: Whole public registry JSON container is machine read and may contain abstract/descriptive aggregate information. Researcher output excludes descriptions, arbitrary XML, measurement values and data-file bodies. Existing primary-paper qualitative exposure remains; no fresh/untouched-source claim.
retention: Raw registry body stays ignored and outside public allowlist. Publish selected metadata, own paraphrase, the exact citation identity, scope and request receipts.
limits: Dataset DOI identity and declared rights do not verify any file bytes or legal exceptions outside the registry metadata.
Primary Dryad record is distinct from the catalog's processed Figshare file13213475; do not transfer rights or assume row/byte equivalence.
No data/label tables, full articles, notebooks, joins, numeric comparisons, fits, thresholds or admissions.
At most this one network request; no links or repository files followed.
